svg.title: The extension header chain
svg.desc: The IPv6 fixed header's Next header byte is 0: a Hop-by-Hop extension header follows. The parser walks the chain: the extension's own next header is 6, TCP, and its length byte 0 means 8 bytes. So next_header is 0, extension_headers holds the 8 bytes, transport_protocol is Some(6), and the payload starts after the chain. A Fragment header (44) or No Next Header (59) in the chain makes transport_protocol None: nothing is parsed above.
